Our stay with Malika was a dream! Her creative spirit is everywhere and her attention to details is incredible!  The location is 35 meters from the fence of the Pyramids area. The horses and riders are amazing to watch in the foreground of the best view of the pyramids.  Her place is kept immaculate and she offers meals as well.  We only took advantage of breakfast,  but it was wonderful!  She presents the breakfast beautifully and makes meals traditional Egyptian style. Thank you so much for the wonderful hospitality! I arrived quite late, so I asked Malika's driver to pick me up from the airport. Had a great stay. Such an experience, everything was as described. Highly recommend bringing earplugs to sleep, this made everything perfect for us.

The owner was so thoughtful remembering I was arriving for my birthday and leaving a card and some sweets. There is a shared kitchen with a spout for filtered water. Horses neigh just below the terrace and if you want a horse or camel to ride to the pyramids or into the desert FB Stables  is on site and convenient to book. There are shops and restaurants nearby and I’d recommend this place for anyone that wants to leave the beaten path and have a unique experience. We will always remember our time in this place.

We were staying one week at Malikas beautiful home and had an amazing time. However, there are some things you need to know before you stay there which Malika is also very transparent about. You should know there will be animal noises all day and night such as horses and especially dogs barking. Best view of the pyramids in all of Cairo, incredible service from everyone there. Great tours, amazing food (cooked authentically) if you want to eat dinner or breakfast. All around very kind people everywhere willing to help and assist with anything you may need. I’d say it’s the perfect combination if you want the REAL Cairo with everyday Pyramid Sunsets and Sunrises!

Malika and the whole team who supported our visit (2x Kareems :) ) were very friendly and responsive during our stay. Some notes for others: The local area (like most of Egypt's major cities) is noisy 24 hours a day, as the team describes. As a 'normie' tourist, you might find the constant engagement from all of the vendors in the local area tiring. This has nothing to do with Malika and the team; it is an integral part of the Egypt experience! Be friendly, say no thank you, and smile. Thanks, Malika!

“Live like a local” is Airbnb’s motto…and this is exactly what Malika’s place (and the surroundings) offer. We had a very nice stay at Malika’s place and loved the surroundings! Walking distance to the Sphinx entrance (20 min) and splendid views over the pyramids. We would stay again :-)

The location is very busy and hard to find - would recommend reaching out in advance with your arrival time to the hotel so they can be ready to greet you and help you find the entrance. The breakfast is delicious and the staff very friendly and helpful. Thank you Mohamed, Mustafa, and Amr!

The host was very kind and helpful to us when a maintenance issue occurred during our stay. The view of the pyramids is amazing and they will definitely look after you well, it’s just good to know that it can feel like quite an unsafe area and you will usually get a different person greeting you at the airport or the Airbnb. This is fine but I think we would have liked to have known this before we arrived. Sadly we had to wait for our taxi for 30 mins at the airport and then couldn’t find him when we were promised someone would greet us with a sign on arrival. As a woman I was okay because I was with my husband however if I was on my own or with just women I wouldn’t have felt comfortable in this Airbnb. This isn’t a complaint just something I wanted to preface!

We had an absolutely wonderful experience at this accommodation. There were several hosts, and each of them was incredibly friendly, helpful, and thoughtful. They truly made our stay exceptional and made us feel at home right away. They offered great suggestions, helped us arrange tours, and took care of almost everything we needed. Overall, our stay exceeded all expectations, and the people who work here really made all the difference for us. I wholeheartedly recommend this place to everyone, no doubt about it. Once again, thank you so much for taking such good care of us and for your warm hospitality. ❤️

The room itself was fantastic. Just like the photos — clean, comfortable, epic view of the pyramids. But the area is NOT for a solo female traveler. I was here for a couple of days before I met up with my official group, and I stayed in the room as much as possible. While Farag was super helpful and communicative, he set me up with a scam camel ride that was grossly overpriced and went through military grounds that we were not allowed in, and back streets that were extremely dangerous. Thank goodness I had a friend with me. Do not book a “camel tour” with them. This place is suitable for a quick stay with company, but I highly advise new Cairo or somewhere that’s gated. Especially if you are alone and want to walk around safely.

This place was so nice and the views are absolutely gorgeous! The entire staff was incredibly helpful—no matter what I needed, someone was always there to assist. I truly felt like I was surrounded by friends the entire time. As a solo female traveler, I really appreciated how comfortable and welcomed I felt. Highly recommend this location!

This inn is soooo nice! The Internet of Cairo International Airport was completely shutdown yesterday. The driver Farag still waiting for me in the midnight. The inn staff are very enthusiastic and hospitable. They show me around the Giza and make delicious breakfast for me! This is an unforgettable experience and I will appreciate them all🥰

World class hospitality. The entire team went above and beyond to ensure we had a wonderful visit. I especially appreciate how they connected us to drivers, guides and experiences to take the stress of planning off our hands. It is very walkable near the pyramids and top rated restaurants, although I highly recommend the food at the hotel- just wonderful! We felt like we were taken care of. They really do treat you like family.
Lovely view - great staff, amazing cook for breakfast. Shout out to the cook again.
I can’t overstate how wonderful our stay was. If you enjoy adventure and being at the center of it all, this is the place to stay — an absolute must.
The host Mohamed is amazing and even the helper with the bags is also a great help! We really enjoyed staying here for the second time and we highly recommend

The place really is a jewel in the reef! Great views of the pyramids in some rooms. 307 and 201 good rooms. It’s a busy tourist area obviously because you are the foot of the pyramids. Pay half of what people say and still bargain from there. Warm charming people but naturally out to survive so haggling is everywhere, prepare yourself. The hotel is a haven where you can come and regroup and relax.  I caught Ubers everywhere and that was fine. The staff at reception were all lovely and responsive to my needs. A great massage place just up on the corner. Very professional and safe. Buy some perfume oils in the many shops along the same street. Check that it’s authentic by dropping a drop into water in the shop if it sinks it’s real if it floats on the top it’s not. I highly recommend this place for a couple of nights when seeing the pyramids and sphinx and light show camel trip or horse and cart or quad bikes up to the base of the pyramids! Just awesome !!
